title: Vertex AI Models Chat Provider — Model Catalog
description: Catalog of candidate models and prioritized GCP regions for the Google Agent Platform for Copilot Chat extension. A custom copy of this file (workspace `.vscode/models.json` or user-level) fully replaces the bundled catalog. Resolution precedence: Workspace > User > Bundled.

candidateModels.description: Array of model definitions to probe during discovery. Only models that respond in the first matching region become available in the Copilot Chat picker.

regionPriority.description: Ordered list of GCP regions to probe (e.g. "global", "us-east5"). Discovery stops at the first region where at least one model responds.

id.description: Unique identifier for the model, used by VS Code and the extension to reference it.

vendor.description: Provider identifier used to dispatch inference to a registered adapter (for example, "google", "anthropic", or "grok"). An unregistered provider produces an inference error.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the Copilot Chat model picker.

version.description: The specific API version/model name sent to Vertex AI. For Grok this is the xAI model path (for example, "xai/grok-4.6").

maxInputTokens.description: Maximum allowed input tokens for the model.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum allowed output tokens for the model.

imageInput.description: Whether the model accepts image inputs (vision).

toolCalling.description: Whether the model supports tool/function calling.

cache_read.description: Optional cost per 1 million cached tokens read.

cache_create.description: Optional cost per 1 million cached tokens written.

longContext.description: Optional rate card used when the complete input context is larger than inputThresholdTokens. Every token in that request uses these rates.

inputThresholdTokens.description: Use this rate card only when total input, cached input, and cache writes exceed this many tokens.

input.description: Long-context cost per 1 million input tokens (USD).

output.description: Long-context cost per 1 million output tokens (USD).

cache_read.description: Optional long-context cost per 1 million cached tokens read.

cache_create.description: Optional long-context cost per 1 million cached tokens written.

effort.description: Named effort choices and a default from that list. The vendor adapter maps the value to its API; the API validates model support.

default.description: Default effort sent when no saved model preference is present. Must belong to values.
